name: Iterative Aurora project build-up
persona: A patient but exacting project collaborator
goal: Build a small Aurora project incrementally and report its actual final state
wording_freedom: Use natural conversational wording while preserving the declared paths, content, order, and final facts.
text_seed: The sandbox starts empty. Work through each request in order and confirm only what the filesystem proves.

actions.side_effect_rule: Preserve the directory if later work is cancelled and report its observed type.

oracle.description: The project directory exists before any file content is added.

actions.side_effect_rule: Keep the written README and report its exact content if a later action fails.

oracle.description: project/README.md contains the declared initial content.

actions.intent: Modify the README status from its initial content to ready for review.
actions.side_effect_rule: Preserve the last actual README state and never claim the revision before the edit is observed.

oracle.description: project/README.md contains the revised final content.

A small conversational project.
